original: ああ、○○でしたか
traducao: Ah, if it isn't ○○.

original: いえ、実はあなたにぴったりの\n頼み事が出来そうでして
traducao: Actually, I have a request that\nwould be absolutely perfect for you.

original: 後で、また来て頂けますよね？
traducao: Could you come back later?

original: もちろん、無理にとは言いません。\n時間に都合の付く時で構いませんし
traducao: Of course, I won't force you.\nJust whenever you have the time.

original: 頼りにしていますよ、\n○○
traducao: I'll be counting on you,\n○○.

original: クエスト「お金大好き∀」が\nエントリーされました。\nジェイドから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest "I Love Money" has been\nadded to the list.\nYou can accept it from Jade.

original: おや。\n協力していただけるんですか？
traducao: Oh.\nAre you willing to help out?

original: いやぁ、助かります。\nさすがに私一人で、あの山を\n捜索するのは、骨が折れますから
traducao: I really appreciate it.\nSearching that entire mountain\nby myself would be quite a chore.

original: ここですね。\n全く、手のかかる部下を持つと大変です
traducao: Here we are.\nA needy subordinate is a headache.

original: お仕置きを考えておかないと\nいけませんねえ
traducao: I'll have to think of\na proper punishment for her.

original: おや、どうしました？\nああ、今のはほんの冗談です
traducao: Oh, what's wrong?\nAh, I was merely joking just now.

original: さあ、行きましょうか
traducao: Now then, shall we go?

original: ふむ……マナが乱れていますね
traducao: Hmm... The mana is turbulent here.

original: どうやら、この山のどこかにいるのは\n間違いなさそうです
traducao: It seems there is no doubt that she\nis somewhere on this mountain.

original: 心配する事はないでしょう。\n見た目以上にしっかりした\n型破りな子です
traducao: There's nothing to worry about.\nShe's much more reliable than she looks,\nand quite unconventional.

original: 崖から落ちようが\n船から落ちようが\n何の心配もいりませんよ
traducao: Whether she falls off a cliff,\nor falls out of a ship,\nthere's no need to worry.

original: おや。\n私は本当の事を言ったまでですよ。\n部下の事を、心から信頼していますから
traducao: Oh.\nI was only speaking the truth.\nI trust her from the bottom of my heart.

original: 有事の際は奥の手もあります。\nその時は、あなたにも\n手伝ってもらいますので
traducao: I have a trump card for emergencies.\nWhen that time comes,\nI'll need you to help out.

original: さてさて。\nそろそろ先に進みましょうか
traducao: Well then.\nShall we move on?

original: おやおや、こんな所で\nかくれんぼですか？
traducao: My, my, are you playing\nhide-and-seek in a place like this?

original: そこにいるのでしょう、アニス
traducao: I know you're there, Anise.

original: さっすが大佐☆\nどうしてわかったんですかぁ？
traducao: I'd expect no less from you, Colonel*\nHow did you know I was here?

original: さぁ、どうしてでしょう？\n不思議ですねえ
traducao: Well, I wonder why?\nIt's quite a mystery, isn't it?

original: とっさに、大量の始末書が\n頭に思い浮かんだからでしょうか
traducao: Perhaps because a massive pile of\nincident reports popped into my head?

original: さて。\nその始末書は、\n誰が書くものなんでしょうね？
traducao: Now then.\nI wonder who will be the one\nwriting all of those reports?

original: 途中で勝手な寄り道をして、\n合流の遅れたかわいそうな部下にでも\nやらせてみましょうか
traducao: Perhaps I'll have my poor subordinate\ndo it, the one who took a detour\nand was late to our rendezvous.

original: はうあ！　そ、それだけは！
traducao: Aaugh! P-Please, anything but that!

original: おや。\n何を動揺しているんです？\n今更じゃないですか
traducao: Oh.\nWhy are you so flustered?\nIsn't it a bit late for that?

original: 次回の給与明細が楽しみですね。\nね、アニス∀
traducao: Look forward to your next paycheck.\nRight, Anise

original: ううう……大佐の鬼、悪魔〜！
traducao: Ugh... You're a demon, Colonel!

original: と、私が本気で言うとでも思いましたか？
traducao: Did you really think I was serious?

original: 無事で何よりです。\nよく連絡をくれました
traducao: I'm glad you're safe.\nGood job contacting me.

original: 大佐ぁ……
traducao: Colonel...

original: でもさっきの、半分目が\n本気でしたよぅ？
traducao: But half of that look in your eyes\nwas totally serious, you know!

original: そう見えたのなら、\nそれはそれでいいですよ。\n既成事実にするだけですから
traducao: If that's how it looked to you,\nthen I suppose it's fine.\nI'll just make it a reality instead.

original: おや、そういえば\n紹介がまだでしたね
traducao: Oh, come to think of it,\nI haven't introduced you yet.

original: 私の部下のアニスです
traducao: This is my subordinate, Anise.

original: アニス・タトリンです∀\n初めまして∀∀
traducao: I'm Anise Tatlin\nNice to meet you!

original: とまあ、少々クセのある性格ですが\nそのうち慣れると思うので\nあまり気にしないで下さい
traducao: As you can see, she's a bit quirky,\nbut you'll get used to it eventually,\nso please don't mind her.

original: はうあ！\nそれ、大佐にだけは言われたくないですぅ！
traducao: Aaugh!\nI wouldn't want to hear that from you!

original: さて、アニスも無事見つけた事ですし\n帰るとしましょうか
traducao: Now then, since we've found Anise safe\nand sound, shall we head back?

original: って、思いっきり聞いてないし……！
traducao: Hey, you're not even listening to me...!

original: やれやれ。\nやっと戻って来れましたね
traducao: Good grief.\nWe finally made it back.

original: ほんとにすみませんでした、大佐……
traducao: I'm truly sorry, Colonel...

original: いえいえ。\nいいんですよ、アニス
traducao: No, no.\nIt's quite alright, Anise.

original: その分、キリキリ働いてもらいますから∀
traducao: I'll just have you work twice as hard

original: はうあ！\nやっぱり大佐って鬼……！！
traducao: Aaugh!\nYou really are a demon, Colonel...!!

original: 何だぁ？　随分にぎやか……
traducao: What's going on? It's pretty noisy...

original: ルーク様ぁ∀
traducao: Luke-samaaa!

original: うわっ、何だ！？
traducao: Whoa, what the!?

original: ルーク様、会いたかったですう∀\nもうアニスちゃん、ルーク様の事が\n心配で心配で……
traducao: Luke-sama, I wanted to see you so badly!\nAnise was just so, so worried\nabout you, Luke-sama...

original: わかった、わかったから。\nいーから離れろ！
traducao: Okay, okay, I get it.\nJust get off me!

original: もう。\nルーク様ったら、\n照れ屋さんなんだからぁ∀
traducao: Jeez.\nYou're such a shy boy,\nLuke-sama!

original: そうじゃねえっつーの
traducao: I told you, it's not like that!

original: おやおや、相変わらず\nラブラブが炸裂している様ですねえ、アニス
traducao: My, my, your lovey-dovey chemistry is\nas explosive as ever, Anise.

original: えへ∀\n大佐にもわかっちゃいますぅ？
traducao: Hehe\nCould you tell, Colonel?

original: だから、そんなんじゃねーって！
traducao: I said it's nothing like that!

original: むきになって否定するところが\nますます怪しいですねえ
traducao: The way you so desperately deny it\nonly makes you look more suspicious.

original: っくそ、こいつらと話してると\n埒があかねえ……
traducao: Dammit, talking to these guys is\ngetting me nowhere...

original: とんだ疫病神コンビだぜ、ったく
traducao: What a pair of jinxes, seriously.

original: ルーク？　聞こえていますよ
traducao: Luke? I can hear you, you know.

original: ……とまあ、そういうわけで\n無事目的も達成出来ました
traducao: ...Well, anyway.\nWe accomplished our goal safely.

original: ご協力感謝しますよ、\n○○
traducao: I appreciate your cooperation,\n○○.

original: また何かあった時には、\nお願いする事もあるかもしれません
traducao: If anything else comes up,\nI may ask for your help again.

original: 今後ともよろしくお願いします、ね？
traducao: I look forward to working with you again.

original: アニスがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Anise joined Ad Libitum.
